title: Running iree-run-module-multi.mlir on two gpu devices
body:

Run:
`./iree-run-module --module=gpu_2devices.vmfb --function=mutli_device_mul --input=4xf32=10,11,12,13 --device=hip:0 --device=hip:1 --task_topology_group_count=1 --trace_execution=true`
